Ahead of the epoch the farm wires 69888 POA and books 3276 minutes of labour, all of it sunk before any prize is counted. The farm practised the ferrous, it practised the umber, but it never practised the bridge, because a year cannot be practised. Honest proofs grow like seed; farm proofs are sawdust, and sawdust grows nothing.
